findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_style_decode, get_my_decode · Private data: get_style_decode, decode_image, get_my_decode, place_in_brain, add_image · Public sink: place_in_brain, add_image · Destructive: add_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_style_decode, get_my_decode · Private data: get_style_decode, decode_image, get_my_decode, place_in_brain, add_image · Public sink: place_in_brain, add_image · Destructive: add_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
